services.name: Walking Tour: The history of Black & Brown Las Vegas
services.desc: tour is for the visitor with a limited amount of time who will like to see and hear about the highlights the Black and Brown history of the Las Vegas strip . This is a walking tour for about 45 mins. Learn about African Americans of Las Vegas from entertainers to civil rights leaders. Freedom Line Tours guide tells the story of what was know as "the Mississippi of the West" during the 1950's to the 1960's and the $200 million dollar industry where the wealth gap is larger than ever. DURATION The tour starts Tuesday through Sunday at 10am to 1pm and 2pm to 45 Minutes • All ages

services.name: Civil and Voting Rights Tour and Historic Preservation day of Service
services.desc: The Civil and Voting Rights Tour and Historic Preservation Day of Service offers a powerful and immersive journey through the heart of the Civil Rights Movement. Taking place from April 14-19, 2026, this five-day, four-night experience will lead participants through the historic cities of Selma, Montgomery, and Birmingham, visiting landmark sites that tell the story of America’s struggle for equality and justice. services.name: Civil Rights History -The Church, Children & Community
services.desc: Book our Civil Rights History walking tour today! 2 Hours About: The Crusaders for Civil Rights -The Church, The Children and The Community, Birmingham, AL Tour is a historical American story many will never forget. This tour tells the story of the evangelistic support in Birmingham and of the crusade for LOVE - the greatest commandment. We will explore the crusade of the brave children who marched for all our futures and the involvement of the business community that culminated in the passing of the 1964 Civil Rights Act. services.name: Super City Birmingham Hop On Hop Off Driving AppTour
services.desc: See the city at your own pace! Around 3-5 hours, all at your own pace About: Freedom Line Tours invites visitors to our adaptation of our Signature Super City Birmingham (TM) Hop On/ Hop Off Tour. This sightseeing tour takes visitors to over 10 attractions throughout the Birmingham Metro Area. Tour with comfort and safety at your own pace, in your own vehicle. Choose to hop out and take photos then to continue your journey. Special guest appearances and activities will be included along the route based on the Alabama Department of Health guidelines.
